reviews.text: I was notified by my new homeowners Insurance that the underwriters would not be able to insure us because of our old roof. It needed to be replaced. I went to Angie’s list and was referred to Platform Roofing. Their Associate Ryan contacted me and we agreed upon him coming by later that day. Ryan presented the information about the installation process and the quality of the composite shingles (Lifetime warranty (50 years)). The quote provided was a blessing from God, based on what friends and family had told us to expect. We scheduled the installation for Saturday. The contractors were there bright and early and completed the project the same day for the most part with additional cleanup Sunday afternoon. Many thanks to Ryan for his patience and professionalism. Also thanks to the contractors for their professionalism and great work.
reviews.author: Carla Thomas

reviews.text: This company replaced a roof on two houses that I own both houses have flashing leaks that have destroyed the roof and interior walls and ceilings.  Instead of replacing the roof jacks, they reused the damaged ones and broke them even more, which made them susceptible to water damage. My insurance company paid for new roof jacks  I do not recommend this company.
reviews.author: H & R Properties

reviews.text: We had ridge vents and inlet vents installed on the attic roof above the garage. Scheduling was flexible to accommodate our availability. Very reasonably priced, and the work was performed to our satisfaction. Highly recommended
reviews.author: Singh Jaspreet

reviews.text:
I have worked with a lot of trades and construction companies and I truly cannot say enough great things about Platform Construction and Roofing! From the moment I reached out for an estimate to the final inspection, the entire team was professional, punctual, and incredibly courteous. Ryan walked me through every step of the process, answered all my questions with patience, and made me feel completely confident in their workmanship.
The crew showed up on time, worked efficiently, and kept the job site spotless. You could tell they take pride in their work. The craftsmanship is top-notch—our new roof looks amazing!
What really stood out was Ryan's professionalism and attention to detail he showed for our property. He definitely has a passion for quality construction.  He went above and beyond to make sure everything was done perfectly—and it was. No hidden fees, no delays, just honest, quality work delivered as planned.
If you're looking for a reliable, trustworthy, and skilled roofing company, look no further than Platform Construction and Roofing. I highly recommend them to anyone in need of roofing services (and in Texas, everyone needs a good roofer)—you won’t be disappointed!
reviews.author: Terry Farmer

reviews.text: In a word… outstanding!! Ryan negotiated with my insurance company to get me the best settlement possible and then he and his crew set to work putting on my new roof and installing the new gutters. Everything came out so much better than I expected. Kinda makes me wish I had more than one roof that needed work.
reviews.author: Susan Anderson

reviews.text:
Mr Ryan is not only kind and generous, but he is professional and dependable as well. He took the time to go over and explain each process and made sure all the paperwork was in order for Insurance. He was very good with communication, and kept me well informed during the whole process.

His crew came out did a wonderful job and were very respectful and considerate. They even painted my A frame on my roof so my daughter or I would not have to get up there.

I was also very appreciative of Mr Ryan as he went out of his way to make an extra trip to pick up a check from me because I did not feel comfortable using Venmo or Zelle. These guys are truly the best!
reviews.author: Lisa Daniels

reviews.text: I cannot recommend Ryan Jones and his team at Platform enough. Stop looking, this is the team you want to hire. Ryan took on a rather large residential project replacing a storm damaged roof, painting the exterior and totally transforming the interior with paint throughout, repairs, and replacing flooring. The project was completed not only on time but on/below budget. The projects were completed with quality work and craftsmanship. In short, Ryan is much more than a contractor, he's a genuine guy that goes above and beyond for you. He truly has the best interest at heart and has become my go to contractor and referral for all things construction.
reviews.author: Eduardo Sanchez, Jr.

reviews.text: Ryan Jones and his team represented Platform Construction in a positive way throughout the process of replacing my roof. Professional, good communications and quality work at a reasonable price - thanks Ryan!
reviews.author: doug mays

reviews.text: I  was very pleased with the professional work that was done.  I highly recommend them to anyone needing Roofing or water gutter repair. Ryan was very attentive and followed up before and after the work was completed.  .  A 5 star company.
reviews.author: Steve Ventura

reviews.text: From start to finish, meeting onsite with the adjuster to final clean up and walk around, Armando and Platform were nothing short of excellent, courteous and professional.  I knew at every stage what to expect in the roofing progress daily. Thanks Armando!  We really like out new roof and gutters!
reviews.author: Ron Eakin

reviews.text: Submitted a request on Angi's list for roof repair/replacement, Ryan text me about it, he wanted me to meet him at the property in Fort Worth, I live in San Antonio, I explained to him I could not meet him there because of that, he got extremely short on text and said he could not help me if I didn't provide him more information and that "he'd been doing this a long time", but didn't text or call asking for any additional information.  Then text me and accused me of running a scam.  Not sure if this guy was having a bad day but was extremely unprofessional, will be reporting to Angi's list.
reviews.author: Spencer Hasch

reviews.text: Ryan and Platform construction have been doing my repairs for probably 15+ years now and I can’t recommend them enough.  Ryan makes sure that you are extremely pleased with the work and makes the experience so easy for the costumer. Plus, every time I reach out to them they get back to me very quickly and answer any question I may have.   They also deal with the insurance companies and make sure you get everything covered.  Highly recommend!!
reviews.author: Sue Axtell

reviews.text:
I used Platform Construction & Roofing to replace my roof and it is absolutely beautiful! We used them to replace our roof with the addition of adding ridge vents and also replacing the decking. Our roof stands out in the best way possible. It's the nicest roof on the block!

Luis & Ryan were amazing to work with! I would recommend them to anyone who needs any work done to their house. They showed fantastic customer service before, during, and even after they completed their job with us. I had a piece of flashing that was questionable months after they completed their job, and they immediately came & addressed the problem.

It is a great feeling to be confident and know that if I have any more problems that they would take care of me. Peace of mind is priceless! Companies that are overall fantastic, trustworthy, and honest are hard to come by. I didn't believe these kinds of honorable businesses existed anymore!

They over exceeded any expectations I had with our project. Don't miss the opportunity to work with Luis & Ryan.

These are my new go-to guys to get any job done. I'm 100% using them again for my future home renovations whenever that time comes.
reviews.author: Samantha Jimenez

reviews.text:
Ryan and Luis worked with us to replace our roof after it was damaged in a severe hail storm and we couldn't be happier with the experience.

We had never been through the homeowners insurance process before and Ryan was able to walk us through all of the steps and work with us and our insurer to ensure that all of the necessary work was covered.  Without his help, much of the damage to our property likely would have gone unnoticed and unprepared.

The quality of the work done on our house was top notch, and we will not hesitate to work with Platform Construction in the future.
reviews.author: Leonard Green

reviews.text: A neighbor recommended Platform Construction to us after having their roof replaced due to a storm. Matt worked closely with us through the process of getting our roof and gutters replaced and worked diligently to ensure everything went smoothly. His team did a great a job and was very professional and thorough from start to finish. I highly recommend this company and would definitely turn to them again in the future. Thanks Matt!
reviews.author: Mike M

reviews.text:
I would give a 0.
First off, the guy from the company shows up and gets pissed off just because he sees his company isn't the only company I'm getting a quote from.  So he walks off & leaves. RUDE..RUDE..
reviews.author: Natasha Ash

reviews.text: Platform replaced the roof on my 1030 sq ft house in only three hours. That was from the time the crew arrived and when they left. They left the yard in great shape and used a large rolling magnet to pick up all nails and metal debris. I am very happy with how the house looks with its new roof,
reviews.author: Diana Lawrence

reviews.text: I had a rental house in Euless and there were a couple of spots with issues reported by the tenant in May 2018. Matt come to review the whole roof and helped me to process a claim from the home insurance. Then he and his team fixed the roof while I was traveling in June. The roof looked great! I sold the house last month. You cannot tell how great it would be when the roof issue got fixed before market the house. This roof company knows what and how to provide quality services. I am very pleased to let this company to take care of my property.  I will use them again for sure. Thank you Matt!  Mei
reviews.author: Macy Wang

reviews.text: Ryan- Was attentive, Fast, and made sure They made Money.. however the Workmanship was Excellent the “little things”… Mattered to Him - And HE made Sure they got taken care of, as with Any installation there is always “Little things you don’t Expect” and He was on top of seeing they got the attention necessary to be taken care of thoroughly. All in All- A Well Done Job in every aspect. AND - Ryan is a Genuinely NICE GUY.  Anyone would enjoy  working with him. I have other projects that I Will Be needing Help to Do.. and I’ll call Ryan First… to Offer He and Platform the Job.
reviews.author: Michael “Zane” Buxton

reviews.text: Ryan was absolutely wonderful. He came out promptly and took care of the roof and gutter work I needed. He was professional, courteous, and very knowledgeable. Will most definitely be using their services in the future.
reviews.author: Mari J

reviews.text: Ryan was great to work with from the start. He walked us through the whole process and met with our adjuster for the inspection. He kept us updated every step of the way. His crew were very hard working (even in this insane Texas heat) and FAST! We will definitely be using Platform again, and recommending to our friends and family!
reviews.author: Amy Yoon

reviews.text: Platform Construction and Roofing helped me install a new roof, make several house repairs and re-stain my fence after a severe storm hit the DFW area. Josh with Platform Construction took great car of me throughout the entire process. I was very happy with the results of their work. They worked very closely with my claims adjuster which eliminated the hassle on my end. I would highly recommend Platform Construction and Roofing!
reviews.author: Jordan

reviews.text: Excellent customer service!  Allen managed the tear down of the old roof and installation of the new roof.  He worked with the insurance company to ensure all damage was documented, and he upgraded the attic ventilation.  He always returned my calls promptly and kept me aware of each step throughout the process.  He even had someone sweep through the yard with a metal detector to remove any nails.  I definitely recommend this company for roofing!
reviews.author: Candice Church

reviews.text: My wife and I had an extremely pleasant experience with Platform Roofing. Due to a hail storm, our entire roof needed to be replaced. Since we were first-time homeowners, we weren't very knowledgeable about the process of moving from insurance claim to a new roof. That's where Platform came in and made all the difference. First, they helped me understand and walk me through the insurance process. Second, they communicated clearly what they needed to do to my roof and the approximate time frame. Third (and most importantly for me), they actually followed through with timely and excellent work on my roof with high quality materials. My new roof not only looks good, but does what it should--protect my family from the ever-changing Texas weather.
reviews.author: Ethan Jones

reviews.text: This was my first time using my homeowner's insurance, so I didn't know how to navigate this well. Ryan was very professional and helped me get every dollar I could from the insurance inspection, plus explained every step and repair. The roof was done in one day (while I was at work) and it is beautiful. Highly recommended!
reviews.author: Vonessa Biehl

reviews.text: Platform Construction and Roofing recently replaced my hail damaged roof and completed additional repairs to the property.  They did an outstanding job from start to finish! This project was managed and supervised by Jeremy R and he is very knowledgeable, helpful, dependable, and thorough.  I cannot say enough good things about him.  Hire him and his team at Platform Construction & Roofing without any hesitation for your roofing needs.  You will be pleased.
reviews.author: King Neale

reviews.text: Platform went above and beyond to replace our roof. They were swift and concise and it was cleaner around the house then before they arrived! The gentlemen that came out and serviced the house were very respectful and polite. We highly recommend them for your roofing needs!
reviews.author: Angelica Mason

reviews.text: Platform Construction provided roofing, siding and several other jobs including repairing our front porch, fence, carport… they went above and beyond in terms of time, materials, recommendations. We will definitely be using them again for future projects.
reviews.author: Julissa Lopez

reviews.text:
I should have written this review long ago! This company is by far one of the best I’ve ever had the pleasure of working with. From the time I made my claim, worked out everything with the bank, and put up with me in the middle of a  huge finish out project… They took care of everything.

As far as the work done, I couldn’t be any happier. I needed a new roof, they were able to get on it immediately and the work was perfect.
reviews.author: Rick reid

reviews.text: I have used this company for several of our rental properties.  One of my investors that I work for originally found them.  I was so impressed by the level of work, the responsiveness, quality and care, i decided to try them out on a couple of other projects, that was 6 years ago and I have been using them and only them ever since.  Ryan and Matt are class acts.  They are very honest and caring, they go above and beyond in every aspect.
reviews.author: Juli Drake

reviews.text: I've used Matt (owner) twice now in the past 5 years for roof replacement.  Each time, he went above and beyond exceeding all expectations throughout the process.  He truly understands customer service and delivering high quality in a timely fashion.  He's a pleasure to do business with and I would highly recommend him to anyone interested in roofing or gutters or any house related development or repairs.
reviews.author: Oday Hameed

reviews.text: They did Ecellent work, and very professional , for a great price too!
reviews.author: k drennan

reviews.text: This a top notch company.  They worked with my insurance company to get us the most coverage possible.  They worked quickly and delivered us a great new roof.  This was a very rewarding experience & I'd use them again.  I even sent them to my daughters house to inspect for damage.
reviews.author: Kevin Harrington

reviews.text: Platform Construction worked on my roof looks fantastic. The owner Ryan was always available and ready to help incase of any issue. Thanks Ryan, I will recommend your company to all my friends.
reviews.author: Charles Mogaka

reviews.text: Working with Ryan Jones is like working with Family. He cared about every little detail that needed repairing. He worked with the insurance to make sure that every repair is done. I fully 100% recommend working with Ryan because he gets everything done and quickly too.
reviews.author: Junior Leeper

reviews.text: Platform just completed our roof after a storm from last year. The project manager Kevin Terrell was great to work with and we are beyond pleased with the services completed. I would recommend using their services.
reviews.author: Gamaliel Benavides

reviews.text: I can't say enough good things about this company! Jeremy was awesome, his customer service skills go above and beyond. Jeremy and his team made roofing and construction easy! No issues and they do excellent work. My house looks amazing. Thank you!!
reviews.author: Lisa Grace

reviews.text: I had a very positive experience with platform construction. They took me through every step in the process, and kept me informed along the way. I received a new roof complete with skylight and gutters. I was very pleased with their overall service, and would recommend to others
reviews.author: Pamela Bolinger

data.summary: Reviews appear largely authentic with a strong pattern of satisfied customers, particularly regarding insurance work and communication from owner Ryan. However, several concerning negative reviews point to potential issues with workmanship quality on some projects and unprofessional communication from the owner when deals don't proceed. The high volume of positive reviews across platforms suggests generally good service, but the specific complaints about leaks and damaged materials warrant caution.
fake_signals: Some 5-star reviews are generic and name-drop the same employee (Ryan)
Limited negative review sample size makes pattern detection harder

negative_evidence: BBB complaint response not shown, but negative review alleges reused/damaged materials instead of replacements paid for by insurance
positive_evidence: Positive reviews mention warranty as part of sales pitch

authentic_signals: Specific project details (ridge vents, insurance negotiations, composite shingles)
Varied writing styles and perspectives (homeowners, property investors)
Mix of praise and specific complaints
Emotional authenticity in both positive and negative reviews
data.discrepancy_explanation: All available platform ratings are consistently high (4.8-5.0). BBB A+ rating with accreditation since 2016 supports legitimacy.
